Hi Elena / Novaforge AP team,

Hope you had a good weekend — quick follow-up on invoice INV-2027-1887 for Jan usage (attached). The invoice moved into past-due on Feb 10 and our revenue ops team flagged the payment attempt as declined earlier today. Can you confirm whether you prefer we:

- retry the card on file (we can schedule a one-time retry within 48 hours), or
- accept a split payment (50% now via card, 50% by wire within 7 business days), or
- provide wire instructions so you can submit the full amount.

I also saw a request for VAT residency docs on your side — I attached the standard tax stub we have and linked the Drive folder with the full VAT packet. If you need anything else from our side to clear the hold, tell me and I’ll escalate.

Next steps: please reply with the preferred payment path and a target date. If third option (wire) is chosen I can send a DocuSign-ready wire instruction and routing stub.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the note. Apologies for the delay — our billing system attempted the corporate card and it declined due to an expiration issue. We can do a split payment as you suggested: card retry for 50% and wire for the balance.

Before we can set up the wire, procurement needs confirmation of Redwood's VAT registration number and the VAT breakdown on the invoice. I downloaded the packet you linked but the VAT ID looks truncated in the PDF (page 2). Can you send the full VAT registration and a one-line VAT reconciliation for the invoice?

Target: if we get the VAT line by EOD Tuesday (Feb 16) we can run the card retry on Wednesday and wire the remainder by next Friday (Feb 26).

—Elena

Thanks for the heads up. VAT reg: GB999888777 (full number — apologies for the truncation in the original export). VAT split on INV-2027-1887 is: base amount $18,400.00, VAT (20%) $3,680.00, total $22,080.00. One-line reconciliation attached in the Drive link and I uploaded a copy to the BILL-342 ticket.
